Retry budget rollout

TL;DR Cap retries with a per-queue budget so a saturated queue sheds load instead of amplifying it. Ship behind a flag, canary one region, then roll out everywhere.

Flow

Failed work returns to the queue only while the budget has room.

flowchart LR
  C["Client"] --> Q["Queue"]
  Q --> W["Worker"]
  W -->|"fails"| R["Backoff budget"]
  R -->|"requeue"| Q

Risks

The retry path can double-fire under heavy load when the queue is saturated.

RiskSeverityMitigation
Budget too small for bursty tenantshighPer-tenant override in the flag payload
Metrics lag the budget by one scrapemediumAlert on the budget counter, not the dashboard
  • Watch p99 enqueue latency during the canary.
  • Abort if the dead-letter rate doubles.

During the full rollout:

  • Abort if the dead-letter rate doubles.

Rollout

Enable the flag for us-east-2 only and hold for 48 hours.

Enable everywhere once the canary holds; keep the kill switch for a week.

Implementation notes
  1. Add the budget counter beside the queue depth gauge.
  2. Read the budget from the flag payload; default to 50 retries per minute.
  3. Emit one log line when the budget refuses a retry.
